environment: Isolated Chrome for Testing; actual history API, synthetic visits and native IndexedDB.

checks.name: History defaults off and a direct import cannot bypass optional permission
Actual user click enables history through optional permission
10,000 actual local Chrome visits match imported native IDs without default-limit truncation
Cancellation, durable continuation and actual worker termination preserve the complete import
Native browser deletion removes cached visits and search evidence
Native search paginates the entire source and exposes real visit provenance
Real v3→v4 upgrade creates source stores without fabricating history
History batch validation aborts its real native transaction without a partial visit
Actual permission revocation removes source cache and invalidates old search
Clear extension history clears import work but never deletes native browser history
Native delete-all invalidates the full source
